summary: Frontend PWA/offline testing at https://shred-tracker-2.preview.emergentagent.com/Gym/. Verified service worker registration, manifest, icons, offline reload, offline navigation across all 4 tabs, and the new Settings 'Install On Phone' hint card. All primary offline requirements PASS.

issues: Pre-existing recharts warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Not caused by this iteration; consider setting minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer.

offline_verification.offline_reload_1: PASS — Today screen (THURSDAY / LEGS + GLUTES) rendered fully offline; bottom-nav visible (4 tabs)
offline_verification.offline_reload_2: PASS — Today re-rendered after a second offline reload
offline_verification.notes: WebSocket errors to /ws are CRA dev-server HMR failures while offline and are harmless (not part of app shell). No fetch errors that block the app shell.

critical_code_review_comments: manifest.json uses start_url='.' and scope='.'. Works when opening from /Gym/ but if user launches the installed PWA and the resolved start_url ever ends up at root (edge cases when installed from a non-trailing-slash URL), scope could be too narrow. Consider explicit start_url='/Gym/' and scope='/Gym/' for production deploy (github.io/Gym).
registerServiceWorker.js skips localhost unless ?sw=1 — fine, but note dev preview succeeded because hostname is *.preview.emergentagent.com.
service-worker.js correctly derives SCOPE from registration.scope so it works on both '/' and '/Gym/'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PWA offline mode fully working at /Gym/ scope. Service worker registers, caches app shell, and offline reloads + tab navigation all succeed. Install-hint card visible in Settings with iOS and Android instructions.
